title: SSL Handshake Exception with Tidepool uploading
body:
![error](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1595541/53294099-fe4e5e80-37e8-11e9-8172-b24a90c2ea32.jpg)
I've checked and double-checked my Tidepool username and password. When I try to test the login within xDrip, I get the error above. I'm using the latest nightly build (23 February). Any suggestions on how to fix this?
p.s., I don't know if living in Egypt makes any difference. In general, SSL works okay, and I have nothing installed on my phone that should interfere with it. It is an old phone, nonetheless, running Android 4.4.
